outcome: Fetal intestinal transcriptional profile (gene expression, signal pathways)
cohort: Eight gilts (sows) with similar age and body weight, randomly allocated to receive either a control or high-fat diet from day 30 to day 90 of gestation, with their fetuses studied at day 90 of gestation.
finding: Maternal high fat intake increased fetal weight and lactase activity, but altered the fetal intestinal immune response, signal transduction, and metabolism.
cross-section timing: Day 90 of gestation (for fetal sample collection)
birth_weight: Fetal weight was an outcome, measured at day 90 of gestation, and found to be increased by the high-fat diet.
gest_age: Fetuses were studied at day 90 of gestation, after maternal diet intervention from day 30 to 90 of gestation.
